steps: Co-branded portal and a launch pack for your team.

linkedin:
How does Get Perks work? Three steps.

1. We set you up. You get a co-branded portal and a launch pack with posters, intranet copy and email templates.
2. Your people ask for help with the things that matter: mortgages, protection, wills and wealth.
3. A broker does the work, start to finish, at no cost to them.

You get anonymised reporting on how your people use their benefits. They get real help from real people.

Find out more at getperks.co.uk

Your home may be repossessed if you do not keep up repayments on your mortgage.
